title: Birds Chirping
blurb: Gentle morning birdsong: the ambient loop that quietly signals it is early and everything is fine. Editors use it in two completely opposite ways. Sincerely, for calm outdoor scenes, sleep tracks and meditation videos. Sarcastically, as the sound of total silence after somebody says something that lands very badly indeed — a comedy staple sitting right alongside crickets. It is also genuinely pleasant to leave running in a tab while you work, which is not something you can say about most of this site.
origin: An ambient field recording of dawn birdsong.
